'''Oak Resin''' is a [[Trees|Tree]] sap made from the [[Tapper]] when it is placed on an [[Oak Tree]], taking {{duration|7 days|class=inline}}, or {{duration|3 days|class=inline}} with a [[Heavy Tapper]].

Oak Resin can be obtained by tapping [[Oak Tree]]s grown by the player or growing naturally in Stardew Valley (''e.g.,'' in [[Cindersap Forest]]). It is also a rare drop from [[Haunted Skull|Haunted Skulls]], and can rarely be obtained after processing [[Hardwood]] in a [[Wood Chipper]].

Although Oak Resin is labeled "Artisan Good" in-game, it does not benefit from the [[Skills#Farming|Artisan Profession]], but instead from the [[Skills#Foraging|Tapper Profession]] (+25% value).

==Tailoring==
Oak Resin can be used in the spool of the [[2 Willow Lane#Sewing Machine|Sewing Machine]] to create the {{Name|Floppy Beanie|class=inline}}. It can be used in [[dyeing]], serving as a green dye at the dye pots, located in [[Emily]]'s and [[Haley]]'s house, [[2 Willow Lane]].

==Quests==
One Oak Resin may be requested by [[Woodskip]] in a [[Fish Pond#Quests|Fish Pond quest]] to increase the capacity of the pond from 5 to 7.
